label: Methanol-Water NRTL Partial Condensation
request: Build and solve a two-stage methanol-water purification train at 1 atm using ideal-vapor, temperature-dependent NRTL-liquid VLE. Feed 100 mol/s at 90 mol% methanol, remove a water-rich liquid in the first flash, partially condense its vapor in a second equilibrium stage, and report product purity, methanol recovery, cooling duty, both water-rich cuts, and molar balance closure.
